measurement.roundTrip: One pg query invocation, including BEGIN, COMMIT, ROLLBACK and failed statements. Connection acquisition is counted separately.
measurement.transactionHold: From successful BEGIN acknowledgement until COMMIT or ROLLBACK returns. Includes SQL and application gaps; excludes initial connection and BEGIN wait.
measurement.scope: Agent phases plus public prompt/status auth and directory SQL. Monitoring and cleanup SQL are excluded. Once-per-isolate outer webhook recovery is excluded.
measurement.phaseRules: Explicit admission, hold, renew, settle, webhook and history contexts. Usage and webhook table statements override parent phase; other retains unclassified agent operations. Receipt and end-user accounting SQL remain in settle.
measurement.history: The load runner does not request history; Workers history uses DO SQLite, not PostgreSQL.
measurement.boundaryCaveat: The complete flag requires no detected object recreation and no inspected pending model attempts or holds. It does not establish quiescence of all non-financial SQL. Snapshots await serial, event and webhook tails.
measurement.resetBoundary: Counts are recorded at query dispatch; elapsed times arrive at completion. A query crossing reset can leave its time in the discarded snapshot, and a transaction crossing reset can record its full hold time after reset without its BEGIN. The runner awaits serial/event/webhook work, but in-flight alarm SQL is not independently counted. Treat non-quiescent and failed stages as observed lower bounds, not exact per-turn timing.
measurement.failedTransactionBoundary: A failed COMMIT closes the profiler transaction interval; any later ROLLBACK tail is not included in that hold interval.
measurement.transactionHoldPerRequestedTurn: Sum of the phase transaction hold milliseconds divided by the requested turn count. Concurrent transactions can overlap, so this is database occupancy per turn, not elapsed turn latency.
measurement.latency: Prompt-to-result latency for successful client turns only, including the 15-second fake model delay. Failed turns do not enter percentiles.
measurement.throughput: Successful client turns divided by the full stage duration, including the same watcher shutdown padding before and after.
